headlines.description: Portugal displayed no ill effects from the drama surrounding Cristiano Ronaldo as the UEFA Nations League holders brushed aside Denmark on Thursday to maintain their perfect record in this season's competition.
headlines.shortLinkText: Portugal shrug off Ronaldo drama to sweep aside Denmark

headlines.description: New Germany manager Jürgen Klopp got his first win with a 2-0 Nations League victory over Serbia in Munich on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wirtz scores as Klopp gets first win with Germany

headlines.description: Wales ended their long wait for a Nations League A win by beating Norway 2-1 in Cardiff.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wales beat 10-man Norway for 1st win in 2026

headlines.description: Alessandro Bastoni spoiled Zinedine Zidane's homecoming as France head coach as Italy earned a 1-1 draw in their Nations League clash in Paris.
headlines.shortLinkText: Italy rally to frustrate France in Zidane's home debut

headlines.description: England produced one of their most dominant performances in recent years as they dismantled Croatia in a stunning 7-0 victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: England put on a show in 7-0 thrashing of Croatia

headlines.description: Sassuolo forward Kieron Bowie broke his Scotland duck with a wonder strike to set Sébastien Pocognoli on the way to his first victory as head coach on a night of landmarks in North Macedonia for the dominant visitors.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sébastien Pocognoli gets first Scotland win

headlines.description: Lamine Yamal scored a superb early goal as world champions Spain beat Czechia 3-1 in Oviedo to maintain their perfect start in Nations League Group A3.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yamal, Rodri inspire Spain win over Czechia

headlines.description: Greece are level on points with Nations League Group A2 leaders the Netherlands after drawing 0-0 with Germany in Thessaloniki.
headlines.shortLinkText: Greece frustrate Klopp's Germany in goalless draw

headlines.description: Gonçalo Ramos is helping Portugal to forget all about Cristiano Ronaldo as he fired Portugal to a 2-1 win over Norway on Sunday to keep the Portuguese perfect in Group A4 with four wins from four games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Portugal stay perfect without Ronaldo in Norway win

headlines.description: Troy Parrott's first-half penalty was cancelled out after the break as the Republic of Ireland played out a 1-1 Nations League draw with Israel behind closed doors in Serbia.
headlines.shortLinkText: Israel cancel out Troy Parrott's penalty to hold Ireland to draw

headlines.description: Wales suffered a 1-0 Nations League defeat to Denmark as Rasmus Højlund struck from the penalty spot.
headlines.shortLinkText: Højlund punishes Danny Ward error to sink Wales

headlines.description: Zinedine Zidane's France belatedly turned on the style as late goals from substitutes Désiré Doué, Ryan Cherki and two from Michael Olise saw them come from behind to beat Belgium 4-1 in the UEFA Nations League.
headlines.shortLinkText: France stun Belgium with four late goals

headlines.description: Pio Esposito's late goal sealed a hard-earned win over Türkiye in Bologna and continued Italy's improvement under returning head coach Roberto Mancini.
headlines.shortLinkText: Italian renaissance continues with runaway win over Türkiye

headlines.description: Spain preserved a 2½-year unbeaten streak by rallying to beat Croatia 2-1 thanks to a clutch second-half double from super-sub Mikel Merino on Tuesday in Split.
headlines.shortLinkText: Spain rally to beat Croatia, unbeaten run up to 43

headlines.description: England captain Harry Kane marked his record-equalling 125th appearance with a brace as Thomas Tuchel's men all but secured their place in the Nations League knockouts with a 3-0 win against Czechia.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kane leads England past Czechia in record outing

headlines.description: Sebastien Pocognoli's first camp as Scotland head coach ended with a grim and damaging 2-1 Nations League defeat at home to Slovenia.
headlines.shortLinkText: Scotland end window with home loss to Slovenia
